correctness.rationale: At each positive reset rate, regeneration uniquely defines the stationary law. The stationary pair recurrence has the same unique solution as the finite-ring or infinite Gibbs law. Spin-flip symmetry gives identical marginals up to order three. value.rationale: Order-four is a rigorous minimal local measurement order able to distinguish a nonequilibrium resetting spin system from an equilibrium nearest-neighbor thermal state that matches every lower-order marginal. The all-positive-rate finite and infinite classification is a motivated structural nonidentifiability boundary, with an exact positive witness rather than an arbitrary small numerical gain.
